researcher_notes: 6 files (P-series.pdf, X-series.pdf, S-series-1.pdf [+byte-identical dup S-series-2.pdf], RS-series-1.pdf [+3 byte-identical dups: -1-2, -1-3, -3], F12ML.pdf, F20MT.pdf). Per agent memory (project_geekplus_series_confirmed, Tech Lead ruling 2026-08-06): the P/X/S/RS-series files never print the company name as extractable text (logo-image only) but are confirmed Geek+ and safe to process without re-flagging. Each series file is itself a mini-catalog with one page per model variant -- 18 distinct model variants extracted total across all 6 files (P500R/P800R/P1200R/P40R from P-series+RS-series files, X1200Z, 6x S-series variants, 5x RS-series variants, F12ML, F20MT). 10 are genuinely new to the DB (X1200Z, S20T, S20C, S100C, S20C-A, S20C-H-SNE, S20C-V3.0, RS5-D, RS8-DX, RS11-DX); 8 already exist and are pure enrichment (every field was NULL). Deliberately conservative field-mapping discipline applied: onboard_container_type/storage_system_type were only filled where the source text itself uses matching vocabulary ('tote', 'shelf') -- NOT inferred from load-size dimensions alone (applies to P-series and RS-series P40R, which do use 'tote'/'shelf' explicitly; deliberately NOT applied to the S-series or X1200Z, whose sheets only give raw millimeter load-size figures without a container-type word). Recurring rotation/turning-radius ambiguity: P-series sheets give a 'Rotation Diameter' figure (not explicitly labeled radius or diameter's exact geometric meaning for min_turning_radius purposes) -- NOT written to min_turning_radius anywhere in this batch, consistent with the same caution already flagged for VisionNav VNK15 and Magazino SOTO (radius/diameter semantics still an open AP0 question).
